description.value: Voxel-based morphometry study of frontal cortical gray and white matter tissue density in abstinent cocaine abusers compared with non-drug-using individuals, including a regression of tissue density on duration of cocaine use.

value: We hypothesized that cocaine abusers would show differences in tissue composition compared to non-drug-abusing individuals and that these differences would be reflected in lower gray matter tissue density in regions of the frontal cortex, where cocaine abusers demonstrated abnormalities in cerebral blood flow during performance of tasks related to executive function .

description.value: Participants were assigned to either a cocaine group or a comparison group and underwent MR imaging after abstinence; the study was observational rather than an intervention.

description.value: Structural voxel-based morphometry preprocessing including reformatting, spatial normalization, resampling, segmentation with bias correction, template normalization, and smoothing.

spans.text: Several preprocessing steps are required to analyze structural MR images using voxel-based morphometry in SPM99
Voxel-based morphometry was performed using statistical parametric mapping software (SPM99; http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm/ ) running from the MEDx 3.42 image analysis program
The MR images were received in DICOM format and reformatted to the Analyze 7.5 image volume format.
The segmented gray matter and white matter images were finally smoothed with a 12-mm 3 isotropic Gaussian kernel
